items.title: AMGEN SECURES PATHWAY FOR U.S. LAUNCH OF BIOSIMILAR TO OPDIVO® FOLLOWING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT
items.summary: Amgen (NASDAQ: AMGN) today announced that it has reached a settlement agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, E. R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C., and Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (collectively, "BMS") to resolve the existing U.S. patent litigation related to ABP 206, Amgen's investigational biosimilar to OPDIVO® (nivolumab). ABP 206 is a monoclonal antibody that binds to programmed death protein 1 (PD-1).
